mechanism: Meloxicam (NSAID) reduces renal potassium excretion by inhibiting prostaglandin-mediated renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system activity, increasing hyperkalemia risk when combined with potassium supplementation.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; avoid potassium supplementation unless specifically indicated and reassess necessity; consider alternative analgesics in high-risk patients with renal impairment.
